name: Cult Initiate
summary: Learn two Warlock cantrips and a level 1 Warlock spell you can cast free once per Short or Long Rest; swap one spell at each level.

benefits.name: Two Cantrips
benefits.summary: Learn two cantrips from the Warlock list; pick Int, Wis or Cha as this feat's spellcasting ability.
benefits.text: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Warlock spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you take the feat).

benefits.name: Level 1 Spell
benefits.summary: A level 1 Warlock spell is always prepared; cast it once without a slot, regaining it on a Short or Long Rest.
benefits.text: Choose a level 1 spell from the Warlock spell list. You always have it prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, regaining that free casting when you finish a Short or Long Rest, and you can also cast it using any spell slots you have.

benefits.name: Spell Change
benefits.summary: Each time you gain a level, swap one of this feat's spells for another of the same level from the Warlock list.
benefits.text: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the Warlock spell list.
